1.consolidated_definition: dep. En el béisbol, pelota bateada con fuerza que avanza por el suelo. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Santana trabajó en base a una recta que rondo las 85 millas y su cambio, se vio bastante relajado, sobretodo en el tercer inning donde retiró a los dos primeros bateadores con ponches y despues obligó a Andruw Jones a batear un rolling para terminar su labor
1.en_consolidated_definition: In baseball, a ball hit with force that advances along the ground. Raw Anglicism, relatively infrequent. Santana worked on a fastball that covered 85 miles and his changeup was quite relaxed, especially in the third inning where he retired the first two batters with strikeouts and then forced Andruw Jones to hit a rolling pitch to end his stint
